description: All day conference must haves ! Stay ready so you don’t have to get ready 🥂 #corporatelife #confrence #leadership
transcript: These are the things that I keep in my bags when I have an all day conference. Fresh socks. I hate having cold feet. I always wear heels. Little snacky conference food sometimes is awful and hurts my stomach. So I always bring my own snack. Hand lotion. This is the girl. It's the hand lotion. It's not greasy. It keeps me moisturized. There's a lot of hand shaking that goes on. I like having soft hands. Colgate whisk. After eating, I have a fix retainer. I like to get in there and make sure I don't have food in there. Chopstick. My go-to. You always need chopstick.
